subject: french
title: Parents & Siblings
welcome_lead: Mum, dad, brother, sister in French.
meta_desc: KS3 French: family vocab, parents and siblings.
final_note: Family vocabulary is one of the first sets you'll need.

walkthroughs.body_html: La mere = mother, le pere = father. The informal maman and papa mean mum and dad — used at home with family.
Le frere = brother. La soeur = sister. To talk about more than one: les freres, les soeurs.
Use J'ai = I have. 'J'ai un frere et deux soeurs' = 'I have one brother and two sisters'. Number first, then person.

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I have' in French?
What is the most common informal way to form a yes/no question in French?
options: Rising intonation (statement said as a question) or using 'est-ce que'.

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I'm going to my friend's house' in French?
options: Je vais à la maison de mon ami.

mcqs.q: What does 'mes parents' mean in French?
options: It always means all my relatives.
My parents (mother and father specifically) - but 'parents' can also mean relatives more broadly.
